name: Platform

length.label: Length (m)
length.desc: Deck extent along local X. Drag the dot on either end face to resize in the viewport; the frame, railing and columns reflow to match.

width.label: Width (m)
width.desc: Deck extent along local Z. Drag the dot on either side face to resize in the viewport.

height.label: Height (m)
height.desc: Height of the deck top above whatever it stands on, which is also the column length. The origin is the deck top, so raising the platform regrows the columns to reach the floor rather than leaving them hanging.

deckSurface.label: Deck surface
deckSurface.desc: What the deck is made of. Tread plate is the steel walking surface of an access platform; a solid deck is what an equipment platform carrying conveyors or machines has. Only the look changes.

color.label: Steel color
color.desc: Steel tint of the frame, columns and railing.

showRailings.label: Perimeter railing
showRailings.desc: Guard railing around the deck edge. Turning it off removes the barrier a walking pilot leans on, not just the visual.

showSupports.label: Middle supports
showSupports.desc: Interior columns under a large deck, in addition to the corner ones. Cosmetic on a small platform, which the corners already carry.
